dp.stage0_route: parameter element e materialState over every element (all points), value 0 (DP: 0 elastic, 2 elastoplastic; 1 is elastic with rescaled moduli)
dp.flip_route: parameter element e materialState over every element (all points), value 2 (DP: 0 elastic, 2 elastoplastic; 1 is elastic with rescaled moduli)

sanisand.stage0_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)
sanisand.flip_route: parameter element e materialState 1 over every soil element (all 8 points), updateParameter 1.0 (id 5: Elastic2Plastic at every point)
sanisand.preshear_params: SANISAND poissonRatio (id 7) -> 0.05 at every soil point

alpha_moved.note: FE Gauss points, ||alpha(after_preshear) - alpha(after_hold)||; the MPM validity condition (>= 50 % of particles) is the harness's, on particles

hs.stage0_route: updateMaterialStage -material 1: reaches ONE element's points; the rest flip lazily (SANISAND without Elastic2Plastic; HS full transition)
hs.flip_route: parameter element e materialState 1 over every soil element (all 8 points), updateParameter 1.0 (id 13: applyStageTransition at every point)
hs.preshear_params: none: LadrunoHS answers no Poisson parameter (setParameter names: E50, Eoed, Eur, c, phi, psi, G0, gamma07, OCR, pop, rho, stage; LadrunoHS.cpp:1172-1250); gravity +30 % only

dp_mildcone.flip_route: parameter element e materialState over every element (all points), value 2 (DP: 0 elastic, 2 elastoplastic; 1 is elastic with rescaled moduli)
